text: A seated person relaxes on a park bench, leaning back comfortably. Both hands rest loosely on the lap in front of the body. Feet on the floor. Small natural movements.

scene.description: Start at bench.post_sit_1 facing the model standing marker direction. A person rests on a park bench with their torso gently reclined backward. Stay in this comfortable relaxed seated pose with subtle breathing and small natural balance adjustments. Hips touches the physical model marker hip_seat_front at 0.00s, 3.00s. LeftFoot touches the physical model marker foot_left at 0.00s, 3.00s. RightFoot touches the physical model marker foot_right at 0.00s, 3.00s. Both hands follow the described pose or natural arm swing; hands with no task remain relaxed. Rest hips on the seat surface; keep the back in front of the backrest and feet clear of the legs.
